arguments.command:
cat << 'PYEOF' > /tmp/post_leaderboard.py
import json, urllib.request, urllib.parse, os

BOT_TOKEN = ***"SLACK_BOT_TOKEN"]
BASE_URL = os.environ.get("SLACK_URL", "https://slack.com/api")

def api_call(endpoint, params=None, data=None):
    url = f"{BASE_URL}/api/{endpoint}"
    if params:
        url += "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    if data:
        payload = urllib.parse.urlencode(data).encode()
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=payload, headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {BOT_TOKEN}",
            "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
        })
    else:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {BOT_TOKEN}"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read())

# Load results
with open("/tmp/slack_leaderboard.json") as f:
    results = json.load(f)

top3 = results["ranking"][:3]

# Build the leaderboard message
msg_text = "🏆 *Weekly Reaction Leaderboard* 🏆\n"
msg_text += "Who got the most love on their messages across public channels this past week:\n\n"

for entry in top3:
    name = entry["name"]
    total = entry["total_reactions"]
    rank = entry["rank"]
    
    medals = {1: "🥇", 2: "🥈", 3: "🥉"}
    medal = medals.get(rank, "")
    
    msg_text += f"{medal} *{rank}. {name}* — {total} reactions\n"
    
    # Show their top message
    top_msg = entry["messages"][0]
    preview = top_msg["text"][:120]
    if len(top_msg["text"]) > 120:
        preview += "..."
    msg_text += f"   └ #{top_msg['channel']}: \"{preview}\"\n"
    msg_text += f"   └ Reactions: {top_msg['details']}\n\n"

msg_text += "Self-reactions excluded — this is pure team love. 💛\n"
msg_text += f"_Scanned all public channels, {results.get('total_messages', 'N/A')} messages reviewed._"

print("=== Message to post ===")
print(msg_text)
print("\n=== Posting to #general ===")

# Find #general channel ID
channels_resp = api_call("conversations.list", {"types": "public_channel", "limit": 200})
general_id = None
random_id = None
for ch in channels_resp.get("channels", []):
    if ch["name"] == "general" and not ch.get("is_archived"):
        general_id = ch["id"]
    if ch["name"] == "random" and not ch.get("is_archived"):
        random_id = ch["id"]

print(f"#general channel ID: {general_id}")
print(f"#random channel ID: {random_id}")

# Post to #general
post_resp = api_call("chat.postMessage", None, {
    "channel": general_id,
    "text": msg_text
})
print(f"Post to #general: {post_resp}")

# Tom Wilson (winner) got 30 reactions, which is > 20 — that's a crush, cross-post to #random
winner = top3[0]
if winner["total_reactions"] >= 20:
    cross_post = (
        f"🔥 *REACTION LEADERBOARD CHAMP* 🔥\n\n"
        f"{winner['name']} absolutely crushed it this week with *{winner['total_reactions']} reactions* "
        f"on a single message in #{winner['messages'][0]['channel']}.\n\n"
        f"\"{winner['messages'][0]['text'][:150]}\"\n\n"
        f"Full top 3 posted in #general. Go give them some more love! 🎉"
    )
    
    print(f"\n=== Cross-posting to #random (winner crushed it with {winner['total_reactions']} reactions) ===")
    print(cross_post)
    
    cross_resp = api_call("chat.postMessage", None, {
        "channel": random_id,
        "text": cross_post
    })
    print(f"Post to #random: {cross_resp}")
else:
    print(f"\nWinner had {winner['total_reactions']} reactions — below 20 threshold, no cross-post to #random")

PYEOF
python3 /tmp/post_leaderboard.py

print("=== Message to post ===")

print("\n=== Posting to #general ===")

general_id = None
random_id = None
for ch in channels_resp.get("channels", []):
    if ch["name"] == "general" and not ch.get("is_archived"):
        general_id = ch["id"]
    if ch["name"] == "random" and not ch.get("is_archived"):
        random_id = ch["id"]

print(f"#general channel ID: {general_id}")
print(f"#random channel ID: {random_id}")

# Post to #general
post_resp = api_call("chat.postMessage", None, {
    "channel": general_id,
    "text": msg_text
})
print(f"Post to #general: {post_resp}")

# Tom Wilson (winner) got 30 reactions, which is > 20 — that's a crush, cross-post to #random
winner = top3[0]
if winner["total_reactions"] >= 20:
    cross_post = (
        f"🔥 *REACTION LEADERBOARD CHAMP* 🔥\n\n"
        f"{winner['name']} absolutely crushed it this week with *{winner['total_reactions']} reactions* "
        f"on a single message in #{winner['messages'][0]['channel']}.\n\n"
        f"\"{winner['messages'][0]['text'][:150]}\"\n\n"
        f"Full top 3 posted in #general. Go give them some more love! 🎉"
    )
    
    print(f"\n=== Cross-posting to #random (winner crushed it with {winner['total_reactions']} reactions) ===")
    print(cross_post)
    
    cross_resp = api_call("chat.postMessage", None, {
        "channel": random_id,
        "text": cross_post
    })
    print(f"Post to #random: {cross_resp}")
else:
    print(f"\nWinner had {winner['total_reactions']} reactions — below 20 threshold, no cross-post to #random")
